scenario_name: Public Transit: Tramway Line 5 Extension in Historic Center

arguments.text: The city must build Tramway Line 5 to improve accessibility and reduce commute times.
The 200M€ budget is financially unviable and will massively increase local taxes.
The ecological emergency mandates building the tramway to reduce CO2, overriding cost concerns.
Surface construction will destroy the 18th-century cobblestone square and ruin the historic center.
We can build an underground tunnel alternative to completely bypass the historic square.
Prolonged tunnel construction will bankrupt local shops around the square.
The city has provisioned a financial rescue package to compensate affected businesses.
The tunnel entrance requires cutting down the centenary trees in the City Park.
Those trees are diseased and are already scheduled for removal next year anyway.
The modern glass tram stations will clash horribly with the city's classical architecture.
